digest.component_or_area: plan review pre-check / DET cited-anchor verification
propositions: When a plan is re-reviewed after a BLOCK verdict with recorded blocking findings, a deterministic pre-check must compare the current plan material against cited evidence anchors (quoted plan fragments) recorded in the blocking review's sidecar.

If the plan's description component fingerprint is unchanged and at least one cited anchor remains verbatim in the current material, a WARNING must be logged naming the persisting findings' criteria before the review executes.
The pre-check must be warn-only with no hard-block, decline, new flag, or exit-code change, because ~8% of BLOCK→PASS flips occur with no material change (verdict flap).
Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim are treated as unmatchable and never trigger the warning alone; the warning fires only when matched anchors are all untouched.
Every plan review must record the precheck.cited_anchor_warning metric (true or false) in the sidecar so warning hit rate and predictive value are measurable offline.
